name: Maine Mold & Machine
old_description: Maine Mold & Machine, Inc. specializes in plastic injection molding. With our molding capabilities, we can do the modification and repair of the molds, part assembly as well as plastic part production - all under one roof.
about:
Maine Mold & Machine, Inc. operates from Hartford, Maine, where it was founded in 1985. The company has served the New England region for decades, providing plastic injection molding services from its facility on Town Farm Road.

The shop specializes in plastic injection molding and offers mold modification and repair, part assembly, and full plastic part production under one roof. It processes a wide range of materials, from basic plastics to highly engineered resins, and handles orders from short-run sampling to long-term, high-volume production runs.

Its customer base spans industrial filtration systems, military components, medical devices, fishing industry equipment, home gaming products, and other specialty sectors. The company primarily serves clients across Maine, Vermont, New Hampshire, Massachusetts, and Rhode Island.

Maine Mold & Machine emphasizes its integrated approach—combining mold maintenance, assembly, and production in a single facility—as a way to streamline lead times and quality control for customers with diverse volume requirements.
